Claim 1 (Currently amended): A loading ramp, said loading ramp comprising: a support structure having a mounting member, said mounting member being compatible with a truck having a bed such that said support structure is adapted to be removably mounted to the truck; a first gradient member secured to said support structure, said first gradient member defining a first surface, a proximate end, and a distal end, the proximate end being opposite the distal end with respect to the first surface, the proximate end being proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, the first surface being structured to support a small vehicle; and a second gradient member secured to said first gradient member at the distal end such that said second gradient member pivots at the distal end to the extent that said second gradient member is capable of an up position and a down position, said second gradient member defining a second surface, the second surface being structured to support the small vehicle, said first gradient member and said second gradient member defining a gradient between a ground surface and the bed of the truck when said second gradient member is at the down position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, the gradient being traversable by the small vehicle, said loading ramp being carried by the truck when said second gradient member is at the up position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, said loading ramp not limiting the storage space provided by the truck when said loading ramp is carried by the truck, __wherein said second gradient member is pivotally secured to said first gradient member by a pivot pin extending through both said first gradient member and said second gradient member__.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said loading ramp makes available storage space provided by the truck otherwise occupied when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, __and wherein said first gradient member includes a frame structure that supports said small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 2 wherein said loading ramp supports at least a portion of the small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck __by positioning said small vehicle on said first surface of said first gradient member__.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said mounting member is compatible with a receiver-type hitch __and includes a hitch pin for securing said mounting member within the receiver-type hitch__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said support structure is adjustable such that the proximate end of said first gradient member is proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck regardless of the size of the truck, __and wherein said support structure includes telescoping members that allow adjustment of a distance between said mounting member and said first gradient member__.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against a rear bumper of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck __and includes a bumper contact pad at said proximate end__.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck __and includes a bed contact surface configured to engage a tailgate of the truck__.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a solid surface __having a non-slip texture__.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a solid surface __having traction-enhancing features__.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a mechanical device, said mechanical device moving said second gradient member between the up position and down position, __wherein said mechanical device includes a hydraulic actuator connected between said first gradient member and said second gradient member__.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a locking member, said locking member locking said second gradient member at the up position, __wherein said locking member includes a latch mechanism that engages said second gradient member when in the up position__.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 20 wherein said locking member includes a mechanical device __comprising a spring-loaded latch that automatically engages when said second gradient member reaches the up position__.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 __for use with a truck selected from the group consisting of a pickup truck and a sports utility vehicle__.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 __for loading a small vehicle selected from the group consisting of a lawnmower, an ATV, and a snowmobile__.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): A loading ramp, said loading ramp comprising: a support structure adapted to be mounted to a truck having a bed; and a gradient secured to said support structure, said gradient having a first gradient member and a second gradient member, said second gradient member being secured to a distal end of said first gradient member such that said second gradient member pivots at the distal end to the extent that said second gradient member is capable of an up position and a down position, said gradient defining an inclined surface between a ground surface and the bed of the truck when said second gradient member is at the down position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, the inclined surface being traversable by a small vehicle, said loading ramp being carried by the truck when said second gradient member is at the up position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, said loading ramp not limiting the storage space provided by the truck when said loading ramp is carried by the truck, __wherein said second gradient member is connected to said first gradient member by a hinge assembly that allows pivoting movement between the up and down positions__.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 26 wherein said loading ramp makes available storage space provided by the truck otherwise occupied when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck __by providing a support platform for the small vehicle when in a stowed configuration__.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 27 wherein said loading ramp supports at least a portion of the small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck __with said first gradient member serving as a vehicle support platform__.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 26 __for use with a truck selected from the group consisting of a pickup truck and a sports utility vehicle__.
